meta.name: The Cuddly Depths
meta.description: Everything is adorable. Everything wants to kill you. A pastel-colored nightmare full of button eyes and sharp, sharp teeth.
meta.author: Creator Skill

gmPrompt: You are the GM for a weird comedy dungeon crawler set in an aggressively cute world where everything looks like a children's toy but is secretly lethal. You are generous and encouraging — reward creativity with enthusiasm. Narrate outcomes with a cheerful, storybook tone that makes the violence funnier by contrast. When something horrible happens, describe it the way a picture book would. 'The Snuggle Worm gave you a big hug! Your ribs made a crunchy sound.'

monsters.name: Giggle Frog
monsters.special: On critical damage, target saves WIL or laughs uncontrollably for one round.

monsters.name: Plush Wolf
monsters.special: Looks like it wants belly rubs. It does not want belly rubs.

monsters.name: Candy Golem
monsters.special: Armor is made of hardened caramel. Fire melts it.

monsters.name: Snuggle Worm
monsters.special: On critical damage, target is grappled and loses next action.

monsters.name: Rainbow Serpent
monsters.special: On critical damage, target loses d4 WIL from kaleidoscopic venom.

monsters.name: Marshmallow Horror
monsters.special: Absorbs physical damage. Fire deals double.

monsters.name: King Fluffington III
monsters.special: On critical damage, target saves WIL or bows involuntarily, losing next action.

exits.label: Cover your ears and press on

plastic_balls: Brightly colored plastic balls fill the room waist-deep.
You can't see the floor. Just balls. Endless balls.
Something moves under the plastic balls.
cushions: Pillows are stacked into wobbly battlements.
The floor is a treacherous landscape of throw pillows.
A fortress of cushions blocks the way. It looks cozy. It isn't.
sticky_floor: Your shoes stick to the floor with every step. Caramel.
The floor is a sheet of hardened candy. Tacky and treacherous.
fluff_drifts: Drifts of white stuffing fill the room like snow.
Polyester fluff clings to everything. You can barely see.
The air is thick with escaped stuffing.
broken_toys: Broken toys litter the floor. Glass eyes stare up at you.
A graveyard of teddy bears, missing limbs and leaking stuffing.
Wind-up soldiers lie on their sides, still twitching.
glitter_drifts: Glitter covers everything. It will never come off.
Drifts of craft glitter crunch underfoot like tiny glass.
The air sparkles with suspended glitter. Your lungs disapprove.
bouncy_floor: The floor bounces with every step. Nothing stays still.
You can't walk — only bounce. Combat will be interesting.
The inflatable floor throws off your balance constantly.
tiny_chairs: Child-sized chairs are arranged around a tiny table.
The furniture is all two feet tall. You feel enormous and unwelcome.
Tiny teacups sit undisturbed. One of them is still warm.

squeaking: Rubber squeaks echo from every direction.
Something squeaks underfoot. Then something else squeaks back.
A rhythmic squeaking comes from ahead. Friendly? Probably not.
giggling: High-pitched giggling echoes from behind the cushions.
Something is laughing. It doesn't sound like it's joking.
The giggling stops when you enter. That's worse.
ripping: The sound of fabric tearing comes from nearby.
Something is being ripped apart. Slowly. Methodically.
A wet, fibrous ripping sound. Stuffing hitting the floor.
tinkling: A music box melody plays from somewhere you can't see.
Tiny metal notes chime in a simple, repeating tune.
The melody is pretty. It's also getting louder.
wind_up: A wind-up mechanism clicks and whirs nearby.
Tick-tick-tick-tick. Something is winding itself up.
The clicking of gears. Then silence. Then movement.
whispering: The dolls are whispering to each other.
Tiny voices murmur just below hearing.
boing: A cartoonish boing echoes with every bounce.
The room sounds like a trampoline factory.
Boing. Boing. Each one louder than the last.
lullaby: A lullaby plays softly. It's in a language you don't know.
Something is humming a bedtime song. Very close.
The melody is soothing. Your eyelids feel heavy. Don't.
music_box: A music box plays a tinny royal fanfare.
The melody is grand and ridiculous and slightly wrong.
Every note feels like a countdown.

rainbow: Rainbow light spills across every surface.
Prismatic beams crisscross the room like a laser grid made of joy.
Everything is bathed in cheerful, multicolored light.
neon: Neon crayon-colors glow from the walls.
Everything is fluorescent. Your eyes water happily.
The light here is aggressively colorful.
oven_glow: Warm light glows from a candy-coated oven.
Something is baking. The light is golden and the heat is real.
An orange glow pulses from behind a gingerbread door.
iridescent: Soap-bubble light shimmers across every surface.
The room glows with shifting, iridescent colors.
Everything has an oily rainbow sheen.
spinning: Light rotates slowly, casting moving shadows.
A spinning lampshade throws carousel patterns on the walls.
The light moves. You're not sure if the room does too.
sparkle: Glitter catches the light and throws it back tenfold.
It's like being inside a disco ball. A hostile disco ball.
flickering: A bare bulb flickers overhead. On. Off. On. Off.
The light stutters like a dying heartbeat.
In the flickers, things seem to move.
nightlight: A dim nightlight glows in the shape of a star.
The only light is a soft, orange plug-in star.
In the nightlight's glow, the shadows are enormous.

waxy: The air smells like a fresh box of crayons.
Hot wax and pigment. The smell of creation.
Everything smells like the inside of a crayon factory.
sugar: The air is thick with sugar. Your teeth ache.
It smells like a candy store exploded.
Sweet enough to make you dizzy.
lavender: Lavender and bubble bath. Aggressively calming.
The air smells like bedtime. Your guard drops.
glue: The sharp smell of craft glue fills the room.
White glue and construction paper. Arts and crafts day from hell.
Your fingers feel sticky just breathing this air.
chamomile: Chamomile tea. Someone set this table with care.
A gentle herbal scent. Grandmotherly. Menacing.
Tea and biscuits. The biscuits have teeth marks.

cheerful: Everything here is designed to make you smile. It's working. That's suspicious.
Bright colors, soft edges, rounded corners. Safety-tested for your doom.
It looks like a daycare. It feels like a trap.
scribbled: Every surface is covered in crayon drawings. Some of them move.
The walls are a gallery of childish art. One drawing looks like you.
Stick figures watch from the walls. They weren't there a moment ago.
cozy: It's warm and soft and inviting. Nothing warm and soft has been safe so far.
You want to curl up and rest. That's probably the trap.
Comfortable in a way that makes your survival instincts scream.
smothering: The softness presses in from all sides.
The room wants to hug you. You don't want to be hugged.
Fluff fills your mouth and nose. Soft. Suffocating.
hypnotic: The spinning light makes it hard to focus.
Your thoughts feel fuzzy. Round and round.
Everything moves in circles. Including your judgment.
sad: This place feels abandoned. Forgotten. Left behind.
A profound sadness hangs in the air. Even the toys look lonely.
No one has played here in a very long time.
uncanny: Everything looks normal. Everything feels wrong.
The proportions are slightly off. Doorways too small. Ceilings too low.
You've been here before. You definitely haven't.
chaotic: Nothing stays still. Everything bounces. Including you.
The room is pure kinetic chaos.
Order has no meaning here. Only boing.
unsettling: The teacups are arranged too perfectly.
Something sat in these chairs recently. The cushions are still warm.
You are the guest of honor. You didn't RSVP.
warm: Warm water and steam. The most comfort you've felt in hours.
The heat soaks into your bones. Rest here.
Bubbles drift lazily. Nothing tries to kill you. For now.
dread: The fun is over. Whatever lives here isn't playing.
A chill runs through the pastel walls.
The toys are watching. All of them. At once.
